gaps: Most chronology and platform generations remain unverified; blank dates are not assertions of current manufacture.
All photographs pending Commons visual/licence review.
Historic Straight Eight and Six families need separate model/series numbers; Oakland predecessors are excluded.
Canadian Pathfinder/Laurentian and Acadian badge identity chronology requires deeper audit. Acadian is not automatically the independent GM Acadian marque.
Bonneville/Grand Am/Firebird/LeMans/Grand Prix multigeneration histories are not complete.
GTO begins as a performance package; initial card is not a claim of standalone model status in 1964.
Streamliner/Grand Safari/Executive/Custom S/Tempest regional reuses, Wave, Sunburst, Firefly, Pursuit and Matiz remain missing or unresolved.
No conversion of US HP or imperial units; most numeric power/mass/dimension/consumption fields remain null.
No exhaustive European/Czech import version tables.
Primary factory document mirrors are used; current mirrors are not manufacturer-hosted originals.
excluded: Oakland-branded predecessors, 1950s Firebird gas-turbine concepts and other show cars.
Trans Am, GXP, The Judge, SSEi and STE are not added as automatic separate model families.
Commercial trucks, race-only cars and customer identifiers.
